event.footerMessage: Grab your cocoa and join the party ☕
gateClosedQuotes: Arrived on time? Strange.. usually you're still in bed!
Go back to sleep, the party hasn't started yet.
I see you trying to enter.. even if you jump you won't get in! 🗝️

rapidFireQuestions.text: Which of these is the safest password according to security experts?
What do you do if your computer catches fire?
options: Send an email to the fire department
Post it on social media first

rapidFireQuestions.text: What is the first rule of Fight Club?
options: You do not talk about Fight Club

rapidFireQuestions.text: If a player is acting extremely sus, what is your immediate reaction?
Who is most likely to crash the production database on a Friday afternoon?
options: The CEO trying to fix a typo

saboteurPrompts: A bad habit you do when thinking hard
Your absolute favorite comfort food when you are sad
Something you bought that was a complete waste of money
A chore you absolutely hate doing and avoid at all costs
A movie or book you pretend to like to sound smart
Your go-to karaoke song when you want to make everyone laugh
Something you are weirdly superstitious about
The longest you have ever gone without sleeping and why
An unusually specific fear you have that makes no sense
The best excuse you've ever used to get out of a boring meeting
Something you could talk about for hours without any preparation
A trend you think is completely stupid but everyone else loves
The first thing you would buy if you won a million dollars
Your dream vacation destination that is NOT a beach or island
mostLikelyPrompts: Who is most likely to order the most expensive thing on the menu?
Who is most likely to become a famous influencer by accident?
Who is most likely to spend their entire paycheck on hobby gear?
Who is most likely to get lost in their own neighborhood?
Who is most likely to win a debate on a topic they know nothing about?
Who is most likely to start a business that sells something completely useless?
Who is most likely to stay up all night reading a Wikipedia rabbit hole?
Who is most likely to keep a secret for 10 years without telling anyone?
Who is most likely to adopt five stray cats?
Who is most likely to fall asleep during a loud party?
Who is most likely to become a stand-up comedian?
Who is most likely to be late to their own birthday party?
lieRatePrompts: I have secretly re-gifted a present someone in this room gave me.
I have pretended to be sick just to stay home and play video games.
I have stalked someone's social media back to 2018.
I have used someone else's Netflix/Spotify account without telling them.
I have lied about my hobbies to impress someone.
I have eaten a whole tub of ice cream in a single sitting.
I have talked to myself in the mirror like I was giving an interview.
I have spent more than 4 hours scrolling social media today.
I have bought something online and returned it after wearing it once.
I have pretended to recognize someone when I had no idea who they were.
I have lied about reading a popular book or seeing a classic movie.
I have secretly muted a group chat because people were talking too much.
I have practiced a conversation in my head before having it.
I have spent money I didn't have just to look successful.

trials.text: Making plans and then asking 'who's coming?' to see if it's worth it.
Leaving one sip of milk in the carton so you don't have to throw it away.
Replying with 'K' or a single emoji to a paragraph-long message.
Stealing the best spot on the couch when someone gets up for water.
Not sending the photos from a trip until 3 months later.
Pretending your phone died when you just didn't want to reply.
Telling someone a story they told you, completely forgetting they were the source.
Taking a bite out of someone else's food without asking first.
Setting 10 alarms in the morning and waking up the entire house.
Asking for a bite of food after saying you weren't hungry.
Singing along to a song when you clearly don't know the lyrics.
Leaving dirty dishes in the sink right next to the empty dishwasher.
Using a ridiculously obscure word in casual conversation to look smart.
Agreeing to help someone move and then suddenly having an emergency.

shotcallerCards.text: Choose one player to sacrifice so the rest of us can live in peace.

outcomes.text: They lost 3 points and their reputation.
Plot twist! They gained 5 points and you lost 3.

shotcallerCards.text: Point to who you think is the weakest link of the squad.

outcomes.text: They lost 2 points and became the room's laughing stock.
The underdog strikes back! They stole 3 points from you.

shotcallerCards.text: Choose the next leader to inherit the throne.

outcomes.text: They gained 2 points and took the lead.

shotcallerCards.text: Form an alliance with another player to dominate the game.

outcomes.text: Both of you gained 2 points and dominated.
Betrayal! You gained 4 points and they got left behind.
They backstabbed you! They gained 4 points and you got nothing.

shotcallerCards.text: Grant immunity to a player. Who is safe from losing points?

outcomes.text: They are immune from losing points in the next round.

shotcallerCards.text: Russian Roulette. Choose a target to pull the trigger on.

outcomes.text: Lucky! They gained 5 points.
Ouch! They lost 5 points.
Nothing happened, the chamber was empty.
The gun backfired! Both of you lost 3 points.

shotcallerCards.text: Choose two players to swap their current scores.

outcomes.text: Scores swapped! What goes around comes around.

shotcallerCards.text: You are the Tax Collector. Collect taxes from everyone.

outcomes.text: You collected 3 points from all other players.

shotcallerCards.text: Trust Fall. Who will catch you, and who will let you drop?

outcomes.text: They caught you! Both of you gained 2 points.
They let you drop! You lost 3 points, they gained 2.

shotcallerCards.text: Interrogation. The target must tell the truth next round.

outcomes.text: They are under surveillance. +2 points if we catch them lying.

shotcallerCards.text: High Stakes. Either everyone gains 2 points, or everyone loses 2.

outcomes.text: Everyone gained 2 points! Celebrating all night.
Everyone lost 2 points! A sad night indeed.

shotcallerCards.text: Judgment Day. The lowest scoring player will either gain 5 or lose 5.

outcomes.text: Mercy granted! They gained 5 points.
Doom! They lost 5 points.

shotcallerCards.text: Expose. The target's next answer will be revealed to everyone.

outcomes.text: Exposed! No more secrets from now on.

shotcallerCards.text: Silence. The target cannot use tokens next round.

outcomes.text: Silenced! No tokens, shields, or help.

shotcallerCards.text: Reverse Card. Any negative effect is reflected back to the sender.

outcomes.text: Successfully activated! You are protected.

shotcallerCards.text: Steal. Steal 2 points from your target.

outcomes.text: Theft successful! Gained 2 points, target lost 2.
Caught red-handed! You lost 3 points.

plotTwists.text: 🛡️ Diplomatic Immunity: The accused is protected!
👥 Mob Justice: Points will be deducted from everyone!
🔀 Switcheroo: One of the judges is now the accused!
